scope.reason: A pre-access implementation audit identified ambiguities and defects affecting online causality, raw-gap resets, tied empirical ranks, day qualification, event latency, state pooling, artifact validation, and enforcement of partition authorization.
scope.precedence: This amendment controls where it is more specific than the parent development charter. All other parent-charter requirements remain unchanged.

online_forecast_and_score_causality.training_windows: Target-complete fit/dev windows may require the predeclared future targets because they are used only for offline self-supervised fitting and validation.
online_forecast_and_score_causality.inference_windows: Forecast-issuance windows require only the ten eligible minutes ending at their anchor and must not depend on any value, missingness flag, or eligibility flag after the anchor.
online_forecast_and_score_causality.score_at_t: A score at minute t uses the observed values through t and forecasts issued at t-1, t-3, and t-5 for their matching horizons.
online_forecast_and_score_causality.availability_invariance: Changing values, missingness, or eligibility after t must not change whether a score exists at or before t, nor any such score value or alarm decision.
online_forecast_and_score_causality.day_boundary: Every issuance window and each issuance-to-target path must stay within one dataset-native calendar day.

raw_gap_reset.trigger: A strictly greater than 60 second difference between consecutive raw timestamps.
raw_gap_reset.minute_mapping: Set reset_before=true for the minute containing the later raw record, including when the two records occupy adjacent one-minute bins.
raw_gap_reset.interval_start: The first minute of every separately loaded governed partition has reset_before=true.
raw_gap_reset.cusum: The Page CUSUM must accept an explicit reset-before vector and combine it with dataset-native midnight and observed score-timestamp gaps strictly greater than 60 seconds.

empirical_rank_ties.rule: For each channel, use the midpoint of the left and right insertion ranks for tied reference values before applying the frozen probability formula.
empirical_rank_ties.constant_reference_behavior: A query equal to an all-constant reference maps exactly to zero Gaussian evidence.

other_requirements: the minute contains at least one raw observation
all seven analogue aggregates are observed and finite
all six safe control inputs are finite after the parent-charter causal state-only forward-fill rule

complete_and_qualified_days.complete_day: A full dataset-native [00:00,24:00) calendar day wholly contained in its governed partition.
complete_and_qualified_days.derivation: 1440 one-minute bins minus the first 14 minutes required by a ten-minute issuance history and the five-minute forecast alignment.
complete_and_qualified_days.development_requirement: All nine complete dev_healthy dates must qualify; otherwise the development power gate aborts before calibration access.
complete_and_qualified_days.calibration_requirement: Only qualified complete days enter the block-conformal order statistic, and at least 39 must qualify.
complete_and_qualified_days.confirmation_healthy_rate_denominator: Only qualified complete healthy days after the frozen fault and 72-hour recovery exclusions.

development_f1_alarm_semantics.comparison: strictly greater than the provisional threshold
development_f1_alarm_semantics.detection_point: the first scored minute in F1 whose two-channel CUSUM envelope is strictly greater than the threshold
development_f1_alarm_semantics.availability_time: The aggregate labelled minute t becomes available at t plus one minute, after that minute closes.

control_state_pooling.no_frequent_state_action: fail closed before fitting the scorer
control_state_pooling.distance: Hamming distance over the five frozen binary control-state channels in their charter order
control_state_pooling.tie_break: lexicographic order of the explicit five-bit control tuple, ascending

checks_before_sensor_numeric_parsing: the partition is authorized for the intent phase
start and stop equal the frozen left-closed right-open boundaries
the timestamp-only row count equals the frozen partition row count
the source identity matches the charter
development credentials cannot request calibration, embargo, confirmation, or post-study partitions
governed_numeric_entry.lower_level_arbitrary_interval_loader: not an authorized formal-experiment entry point

required_pre_access_tests: future missingness does not alter scores or alarms at or before the intervention time
a 70-second raw gap across adjacent minute bins resets and blocks every crossing window
an exactly 60-second raw gap does not independently reset
explicit CUSUM reset begins from zero before adding current evidence
constant tied rank references map their atom to zero and do not create positive Page drift
unauthorized partition requests fail before a numeric sensor scan
partial, zero-score, and under-covered days are excluded deterministically
no frequent control state fails closed
frozen artifact invariants are verified on load
formal runner imports PyTorch before NumPy in the validated Windows CUDA environment
